requirements.text: Administrator authentication requires admin ID 'a' and passcode 'b'; allows two login attempts and terminates after two failures.
requirements.source_quote: - At startup, require administrator authentication. For this experiment, use admin ID "a" and passcode "b". Allow two login attempts; terminate after two failures.

requirements.text: After successful login, administrator can add multiple organizations with unique names, base fare, price per minute, price per mile, and minimum fare.
requirements.source_quote: - After successful login, allow the administrator to add multiple organizations. Each organization has a unique name, base fare, price per minute, price per mile, and minimum fare.

requirements.text: All four pricing values must be between 0.10 and 50.00 inclusive; invalid inputs like '3abc' are rejected and require replacement.
requirements.source_quote: - Each of the four pricing values must be between 0.10 and 50.00 inclusive. Reject invalid values and request a replacement without accepting partial numbers such as "3abc".
